terra.problem: The passage does not say that nobody on the beach had to guess the island's name.
The travelers did land on Crete earlier in the voyage. The passage also does not say the sand on Malta was dry.
The claim about Crete being part of the voyage needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim that Cyprus appears elsewhere in Acts needs a reference.
The explanation says the fire dries the travelers' cloaks, but the passage does not mention cloaks or say they were dried.
The passage does not say the viper was in the bundle or that Paul never saw it coming.
Paul's reason for gathering sticks is presented as fact, but the passage does not state it.
The passage does not say the islanders reached their conclusion in about two seconds.
The passage does not say the viper died in the fire.
The islanders' coming confusion is stated as fact, although the passage does not describe them as confused.
The passage does not say how many people Publius hosted or that he hosted them all in one house.
No guards are mentioned in this scene, but that does not establish that none were present.
The passage does not say whether Paul left the man in bed after healing him.
The passage does not say that word traveled fast or describe the island as little.
The explanation repeats the answer without adding much personality or insight, making it clearly flat.
The passage does not give a crowd size or establish that the sick were a bigger crowd than the soldiers guarding Paul.
